name: Simple Login
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: SpicyMikeHUN
description: SimpleLogin is a plugin/mod that provides a secure login and registration system. It uses SQLite for storage, BCrypt for password hashing, and supports optional TOTP-based 2FA for added account security.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. No classes at the top level of the file (only nested jars); not scanned.
